text: 68k/PowerPC/ARM/MIPS/SPARC shall use manifest-defined synchronous monitor traps/registers with service 0 read, 1 write, 2 fence. Services shall perform the exact nonspeculative transaction, return read bytes in the specified register, restore SP/mode, and obey clobbers. Trap instruction availability alone shall not prove service availability.
